customer_identification.existing_customer: lookup by INN; use existing record; no duplicate insert
customer_identification.new_customer: if INN not found, create PROSPECT record with company_name and inn; loyalty 0%; no cooperation_start_date
customer_identification.missing_identity: ask for company_name and INN; no automatic registration
customer_identification.registration_side_effect: test expected action only; never modify real DB

discounts.stacking: sum then cap per product category

logistics.underfilled_definition: last partial container with 0 < remainder < 16 tonnes; exact 16 tonnes is 80% and incurs no surcharge
logistics.fee_application: grand_total = sum(goods prices excl VAT minus category-capped discounts plus goods VAT) + 50000 RUB VAT-inclusive per underfilled container
logistics.fee_VAT: INCLUDED_IN_50000_RUB; add VAT-inclusive delivery fee after goods VAT; do not charge VAT again
logistics.no_manager_approval_trigger: underfill creates surcharge, not automatic manager approval

money.VAT_rate: read from prices_v6.csv; assumed VAT excluded in unit price
